healer.evidence: Native first heal at Sniper 99: SP 512, final maximum 563 after Blessing 10
healer.expected_effect: Fill final HP/SP maximum; no price, buff-cap, duration or cooldown changes
healer.risk: Low; verify status recalculation and existing-buff refresh
healer.validation: Compare clean and already-buffed characters at levels 1,99,100,255, low/high INT and SP equipment. Require final HP=MaxHP and SP=MaxSP; buffs only at <=99, duration 240s, cooldown 3s, no zeny debit.
healer.discard_if: Any SP shortfall remains, a buff appears above 99, or price/duration/cooldown changes

warpra.evidence: Native level menus omit 25000/50000; account loses exactly that shared tariff on warp
warpra.candidate: Add shared fee to QWS_DLarray preview only
warpra.expected_effect: Show actual total before choice; preserve existing debit; keep production dungeon switch off
warpra.risk: Low; preview must include GM base/depth fees exactly once
warpra.validation: In isolated lab compare preview and net debit at levels 99,100,199,200,255, both map-user display settings, depth 0/1 and nonzero GM base/depth prices. Require preview=debit, unchanged funds on insufficient balance and production DW_OFF=1.
warpra.discard_if: Preview differs from debit, shared tariff is charged twice or production dungeons become enabled
